authority.source_authority: normalized historical records with explicit provenance
authority.financial_authority: none; no price, attribution, payment, or fee mutation
authority.connector_ingestion: deferred to a separate bounded transition

contract.scan: explicit schema, scan ID, tenant, project, rule version, evaluation time, and non-empty record set
contract.revision_order: explicit non-negative numeric order; vendor labels are descriptive only
contract.deduplication_key: project + scope item + location + change type + origin revision/directive + time bucket
contract.eligible_for_review: all verified detection conditions and source provenance present
contract.potential_change: direction or performed work remains unverified while other evidence gates pass
contract.more_evidence_required: missing verification, mapping, evidence, or source provenance
contract.no_opportunity: non-positive revision/quantity delta, remaining allowance, or existing change-order coverage
contract.duplicate: repeated deterministic key retained and marked without dropping history
contract.receipt_hash: canonical decision hash over the complete sorted finding set
